markdownreadme.description:
# Markdown README Viewer

Markdown README Viewer renders `README.md` files directly inside the Nextcloud Files app, similar to repository platforms such as GitLab.

## Current features

- Inline rendering of README files in the Files view
- Support for common and hidden filename variants such as `README.md`, `Readme.md`, `.README.md`, `.Readme.md`, and `.readme`
- Support for core Markdown elements such as:
- headings
- emphasis
- code blocks
- links
- lists
- Support for Markdown task lists (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) with read-only, theme-aware checkbox markers
- Automatic refresh when the file changes
- Clean integration into the standard Files interface

## What's new in 1.0.3

- Added compatibility fallback registration for Nextcloud 32 file list headers
- Fixed duplicate task list checkbox rendering for Markdown task lists
- Stabilized task list rendering by styling plugin-generated checkbox markup directly
- Cleaned up list spacing and minor CSS issues in the README header renderer

## Planned improvements

- Improved table rendering
- Further Markdown compatibility improvements

## Use cases

This app is useful for:

- project folders with developer documentation
- shared team directories
- personal notes and structured folder documentation
- repositories or synced workspaces stored in Nextcloud

## Notes

The app currently focuses on lightweight inline viewing of README files inside Nextcloud. Support for additional Markdown features is being improved over time.

## Nextcloud 34+ Note

Starting with Nextcloud 34, the **text** app (v8.0.0) includes built-in README rendering. Both apps can display a README at the same time. Running both `markdownreadme` and `text` may show two README panels side by side.

To avoid this, disable one of them:
- Use `markdownreadme` if you want a lightweight **inline viewer** in the file list header (read-only, non-editable)
- Rely on **text** if you want a full **viewer + editor** for READMEs in Nextcloud's native UI

# Memories: Photo Management for Nextcloud

Memories is a *batteries-included* photo management solution for Nextcloud with advanced features including:

- **📸 Timeline**: Sort photos and videos by date taken, parsed from Exif data.
- **⏪ Rewind**: Jump to any time in the past instantly and relive your memories.
- **🤖 AI Tagging**: Group photos by people and objects, powered by [recognize](https://github.com/nextcloud/recognize) and [facerecognition](https://github.com/matiasdelellis/facerecognition).
- **🖼️ Albums**: Create albums to group photos and videos together. Then share these albums with others.
- **🫱🏻‍🫲🏻 External Sharing**: Share photos and videos with people outside of your Nextcloud instance.
- **📱 Mobile Support**: Work from any device, of any shape and size through the web app.
- **✏️ Edit Metadata**: Edit dates and other metadata on photos quickly and in bulk.
- **📦 Archive**: Store photos you don't want to see in your timeline in a separate folder.
- **📹 Video Transcoding**: Transcode videos and use HLS for maximal performance.
- **🗺️ Map**: View your photos on a map, tagged with accurate reverse geocoding.
- **📦 Migration**: Migrate easily from Nextcloud Photos and Google Takeout.
- **⚡️ Performance**: Do all this very fast.

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install the app from the Nextcloud app store (try a demo [here](https://demo.memories.gallery/apps/memories/)).
1. Perform the recommended [configuration steps](https://memories.gallery/config/).
1. Run `php occ memories:index` to generate metadata indices for existing photos.
1. Open the 📷 Memories app in Nextcloud and set the directory containing your photos.

MetaVox adds SharePoint-style metadata management to Nextcloud Team Folders. Define custom metadata fields and edit them inline — directly in the file list. Your files stay untouched: metadata is stored separately, never modifying file content.

**10+ field types:** text, number, date, checkbox, dropdown, multi-select, URL, user picker, file link, and more.

**Key Features:**

- **Inline grid editing** — Double-click any cell to edit. Changes appear instantly for all users.
- **Views** — Save column, filter, and sort combinations as tabs. Switch views with one click.
- **Real-time collaboration** — Cell locking prevents concurrent edits. Syncs via WebSocket (notify_push).
- **Client-side filter and sort** — Instant filtering with zero server calls.
- **AI metadata autofill** — AI reads file content and suggests metadata values.
- **Bulk editing** — Edit metadata for multiple files at once.
- **Backup and restore** — Automated daily backups with one-click restore.
- **Flow integration** — Automate actions based on metadata values (notifications, access control, retention).
- **REST API** — Full OCS API for external integrations and bulk operations.

**Ideal for:** SharePoint migrations, document classification, curriculum tagging, policy management, and research annotation. Used by universities, government organizations, and enterprises.

Supports **Nextcloud 31, 32, 33, and 34** with automatic feature detection.

moodle_talk_bridge.description:
Companion app for the Moodle **Nextcloud Talk Session** activity
(`mod_nextcloudtalk`). It lets a Moodle course create a Talk room and drop
teachers and students straight into it, without them needing separate
Nextcloud credentials.

**What it does**

- Receives HMAC-signed webhooks from Moodle and creates, updates or archives
  the matching Talk conversation.
- Provisions Nextcloud accounts for Moodle participants on first use and keeps
  the room roster in sync with course enrolment.
- Grants Moodle teachers moderator rights in the Talk room; students join as
  regular participants.
- Provides a signed single-use ticket endpoint so a user clicking the activity
  link in Moodle lands in the conversation already signed in.
- Exposes a health endpoint backing the "Test connection" button on the Moodle
  side.

**Requirements**

- **Nextcloud Talk (spreed) must be installed and enabled** — this app drives
  it and does nothing on its own.
- A dedicated bot account with an app password, plus the shared secret agreed
  with the Moodle instance.

Configuration is applied with `occ config:app:set moodle_talk_bridge …`; there
is no admin UI yet. See the README for the full list of keys.

**Getting the Moodle plugin**

This app is only the Nextcloud half of the integration. The companion Moodle
activity plugin (`mod_nextcloudtalk`) is supplied directly by Brain Station 23
rather than through the Moodle plugins directory. To request the plugin, or for
installation and support enquiries, contact **elearning@brainstation-23.com**.

n8n_sync.description:
n8n Sync turns a Nextcloud folder into a live, two-way mirror of your n8n workflows.

Bind an n8n **tag** to a folder, and every workflow wearing that tag shows up as a real `.n8n` file — with the n8n icon, its own tags, and its own dates. Edit it in Nextcloud and n8n has it seconds later. Change it in n8n and the file updates itself.

Nothing is matched on filename. Every file carries its workflow's id, so renaming, moving, copying, trashing and restoring never break the link — and re-running a sync never duplicates anything.

## ✨ What you can do

- ✨ **Create, read, update and delete** a workflow from either side
- 🚚 **Move** a workflow — it stays the same workflow — or **copy** it, which is always a new one
- 🗑️ **Trash, restore and purge**, mirrored into n8n's archive
- 🏷️ **Re-tag** it from the Files app, from inside the file, or from n8n
- 🖱️ **Open in n8n** with a click, or open the raw JSON in the text editor
- ⌨️ **Script all of it** — every admin action has an `occ` command

## 🗑️ The Nextcloud trash *is* n8n's archive

Trash a workflow file and its workflow is **archived** in n8n — hidden, not gone. Restore it and the workflow comes back. Only when you empty the trash is it permanently deleted.

It works from the other side too: archive a workflow in n8n and its file lands in your Nextcloud trash; unarchive it and the file comes back out. Personal trash and Team Folder trash, both.

## 🏷️ One set of tags, three places to change them

A workflow's tags live in n8n, in the file's own `tags` array, and as Nextcloud's searchable system tags — and all three are kept identical. Change them wherever you happen to be looking and the other two follow, with no "sync now" click.

That means your mirror is as searchable as n8n itself: filter for every `prod` workflow the Nextcloud-native way. 🔍

## 🎨 Honest icons, honest dates

Workflows register their own mimetype, so they wear the real n8n icon instead of a generic document glyph. And each file carries **the workflow's** created and modified dates rather than the sync's — so Recent, Popular files, and sorting a folder by date all tell you the truth about your automation.

## 🧭 Sync or Link — the folder decides

| Mode | The file holds | Pushes back to n8n? |
|---|---|---|
| **Sync** | The full workflow JSON | Yes — fully bidirectional |
| **Link** | A pointer (id, name, URL) | No — clicking it opens n8n |

Move a sync file out of its folder and it becomes **unmapped**: Nextcloud keeps the full JSON and the workflow's identity, while n8n archives the workflow. Move it back into any mapping and the same workflow is restored — not a fresh copy.

## 💾 And it doubles as a backup

A sync folder holds every one of its workflows in full, so it is also a complete, restorable backup — versioned by Nextcloud, synced to your desktop, and searchable by tag.

📖 **[Full documentation, screenshots and the `occ` reference on GitHub](https://github.com/kubed-io/nextcloud-n8n#readme)**

---

This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by n8n GmbH. "n8n" and the n8n logo are trademarks of n8n GmbH, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.

# NC Connector for mail integration

NC Connector Backend is the central policy and template app for NC Connector mail add-ons.

The Thunderbird and Outlook Classic add-ons can run without this backend. This app adds central policy control, Seat assignment, managed email signatures, custom templates and password delivery rules for organizations.

## What the backend adds

- Central Share, Talk and email-signature policies for Thunderbird and Outlook Classic
- Seat assignment for Nextcloud users
- Group and user overrides for teams with different rules
- Managed HTML templates for Share blocks, password mails, Talk invitations and email signatures
- Separate password delivery as plaintext mail or Nextcloud Secret Link
- Optional Secrets app integration for expiring password links
- Setup diagnostics for mail clients when backend access is not available

## Share policies

Admins can define default share folders, share names, permissions, password behavior and expiry days.

Large attachments can be routed into Nextcloud based on central rules. The mail clients insert clean Share blocks with link, password information, rights and expiry date.

## Password delivery

Separate password delivery can use two modes:

- Plaintext: send the password in a separate follow-up mail
- Nextcloud Secret Link: send an expiring Secrets link instead of the raw password

If the Nextcloud Secrets app is missing or disabled, clients fall back to the existing plaintext password mail behavior.

## Email signatures

The backend can provide one central HTML signature template for Thunderbird and Outlook Classic.

Signature values can come from Nextcloud user profiles and per-user override fields. Empty placeholders remove their surrounding line or table row before the signature is sent to the mail client.

## Talk meetings

Admins can define Talk defaults for calendar-based meeting creation, including room type, lobby, visibility, password behavior and invitation templates.

## When this backend is useful

Use this backend when an organization needs central defaults, locked settings, Seat assignment, managed templates, managed signatures or password delivery rules.

Single users can still use the mail add-ons without this backend.

## Mail clients

- Thunderbird: [https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/nc4tb/](https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/nc4tb/)
- Outlook Classic: [https://github.com/nc-connector/NC_Connector_for_Outlook/releases/latest](https://github.com/nc-connector/NC_Connector_for_Outlook/releases/latest)

## More information

noteberg.description:
NoteBerg is a note-taking app combining handwriting, rich text, and Nextcloud sync.

## Features

### Handwriting & Drawing
- Handwriting input with active stylus and pressure sensitivity
- Pen tool with customizable colors, marker/highlighter tool
- Lasso selection — move, resize, rotate, copy selected strokes
- Eraser tool, unlimited undo/redo
- Mark handwritten notes as tasks

### Text Editing
- Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) with formatting, tables, colors, and font sizes
- Automatic mode switching between drawing and text editing
- Task checkboxes inline with notes

### Media & Import/Export
- PDF import — annotate PDFs with pen and text
- Image insertion with cropping and perspective correction
- PDF export with automatic A4 pagination

### Organization
- Notebooks for hierarchical organization
- Note overview with thumbnail previews
- Full-text search across handwriting and typed text
- Markers tab — browse task markers across all notes
- Recycle bin with soft delete and permanent deletion

### Sync & Storage
- Offline-first — all data stored locally in IndexedDB
- Nextcloud sync via WebDAV with conflict resolution

### UI
- Dark mode / light mode with system preference detection
- Background patterns — ruled lines and grid
- Internationalization — English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese

### Data & Privacy
- All note data is stored exclusively on your own Nextcloud server — no third-party services or telemetry
- Note: uninstalling this app does not delete your note data from the server. Your notes remain in the /NoteBerg/ WebDAV folder and can be re-accessed by reinstalling the app. This is intentional — your data may also have been synced there by the NoteBerg desktop or mobile app.

### Also available on other platforms
- Android: native app via Google Play open testing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.noteberg.app
- Windows: desktop installer from GitHub Releases: https://github.com/thomasleuthold/NoteBerg/releases (unsigned build; Windows may warn about an unknown publisher)

openincryptpad.description:
# Open In CryptPad

"Open in CryptPad" is a Nextcloud application that allows collaborative editing
of files. For this it uses a CryptPad instance embedded into the Nextcloud web
interface. Currently, only drawio diagrams are supported.

## Importing images from Nextcloud into diagrams

With this app, you can import images from Nextcloud into
diagrams. A copy of the image will be stored inside the `.drawio` file.

## Rights management

When using this app, the file permissions are completely handled by
Nextcloud. The right's management of CryptPad is not used for Nextcloud
files edited in CryptPad.

## Installation

### Prerequisites on the CryptPad side

To embed CryptPad into Nextcloud, the "Enable remote embedding" admin setting
needs to be enabled. You can find this setting on the "Administration" web
interface in the "General" tab.

### Install from Nextcloud app store

1. Add drawio mimetype to Nextcloud. "Open in CryptPad" depends on Nextcloud
   detecting drawio files correctly. For this you have to create the following
   files: (**Note:** do this before uploading any drawio files! The mimetype of
   old files will not be updated by these changes)
    - `nextcloud/config/mimetypealiases.json`

        ``` json
        {
            "application/x-drawio": "image"
        }
        ```

    - `nextcloud/config/mimetypemapping.json`

        ``` json
        {
            "drawio": ["application/x-drawio"]
        }
        ```
2. Open the "Apps" page in your Nextcloud web interface and install "Open in
   CryptPad". You can find it in the "Integration" category.
3. Configure "Open in CryptPad" in the administration settings of Nextcloud.

(\*) Don't forget to set the device name in the link (rather than in the logging app settings). Replace "yourname" with the desired device name.
Setting the device name in logging app settings only works with Owntracks, Traccar and OpenGTS.

On PhoneTrack main page, while watching a session, you can :

- 📍 Display location history
- ⛛ Filter points
- ✎ Manually edit/add/delete points
- ✎ Edit devices (rename, change colour/shape, move to another session)

- 🔒 [Reserve a device name](https://github.com/julien-nc/phonetrack/blob/main/doc/user.md#device-name-reservation) to make sure only authorized user can log with this name
- 🗓 Toggle session auto export and auto purge (daily/weekly/monthly)
- ◔ Choose what to do when point number quota is reached (block logging or delete oldest point)

Public page and public filtered page work like main page except there is only one session displayed, everything is read-only and there is no need to be logged in.

previewgenerator.description:
The Preview Generator app allows admins to pre-generate previews. The app listens to edit events and stores this information. Once a cron job is triggered it will generate start preview generation. This means that you can better utilize your system by pre-generating previews when your system is normally idle and thus putting less load on your machine when the requests are actually served.

The app does not replace on demand preview generation so if a preview is requested before it is pre-generated it will still be shown.
The first time you install this app, before using a cron job, you properly want to generate all previews via:
**occ preview:generate-all -vvv**

The preview queue will be processed automatically by a background job if the system cron background job mode is configured in Nextcloud. Additionally, you may run **occ preview:pre-generate -vvv** to a process the queue of pending previews immediately.

quicknotes.description:
Take quick notes on small cards, organized by colors and tags, with basic rich
text — bold, italic, lists — and any file of your Nextcloud attached to them.

Notes can be shared with other people and with groups, and every share says what
it allows: can view, can edit, or pass the note on. Editing a shared note is real
collaboration, and if two people save at once the second one is told rather than
quietly overwriting the first. The attachments travel with the note: whoever can
see it can see them, and images, video and audio open in the Nextcloud viewer.

What belongs to the note is the same for everybody — the title, the content, the
colour, the attachments. What belongs to you is yours: your pin, your tags, your
reminder and whether you archived it. Pinning a note somebody shared with you
does not pin it for them, and two people can be reminded of the same note at
their own time.

A reminder arrives as a Nextcloud notification, and can also be published as a
read-only calendar for the Calendar app and any CalDAV client.

richdocumentscode.description:
**This app has to be installed and used together with the [Nextcloud Office](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/richdocuments) integration app.**

Collabora Online is a powerful LibreOffice-based online office suite with collaborative editing, which supports all major documents, spreadsheet and presentation file formats and works together with all modern browsers.

* This app provides a built-in server with all of the document editing features of Collabora Online.
* Easy to install, for personal use or for small teams.
* A bit slower than a standalone server and without the advanced scalability features.

**System Requirements:**
- Linux running on ```x86-64``` or ```arm64/aarch64```
- A ```glibc``` based distribution/container (```musl libc``` is **not** supported)
- Fontconfig (```libfontconfig.so.1```)
- Additional requirements can be found in [here](https://github.com/CollaboraOnline/richdocumentscode#richdocumentscode)

*The download is rather big so it is possible you will experience a time-out when installing via the web interface.* You can use the OCC command install the built-in server from the command-line instead:

```
sudo -u wwwrun php -d memory_limit=512M ./occ app:install richdocumentscode
```
Where `wwwrun` is the user of your web server. This is ```www-data``` on Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives, `wwwrun` on SUSE based distributions, `apache` on Red Hat/Fedora and `http` on Arch linux and derivatives.

Updates can be done like this:
```
sudo -u wwwrun php -d memory_limit=512M ./occ app:update --all
```

Of course, alternatively you could increase memory usage and PHP time-outs by default, see the [Nextcloud documentation.](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/configuration_files/big_file_upload_configuration.html?highlight=php%20timeout#configuring-your-web-server)

Additional troubleshooting tips can be found [here](https://github.com/CollaboraOnline/richdocumentscode?tab=readme-ov-file#troubleshooting).

safe_html_viewer.description:
Adds a **"Safe HTML preview"** file action to `.html` / `text/html` files. The file opens in a new tab served under a strict `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts allow-popups` — deliberately **without** `allow-same-origin` — so embedded JavaScript can run (charts, animations, interactive reports) while staying fully isolated from your Nextcloud session, cookies, DOM and same-origin APIs.

**Features**

- One-click sandboxed preview of HTML files right from the Files app
- Respects Nextcloud permissions: only files visible to the logged-in user can be previewed
- Best-effort display-time redaction of secrets: email addresses, phone-like strings, IPv4 addresses, private/localhost URLs, and credential-like strings (`password=`, `token=`, `api_key=`, long opaque tokens)
- The original file is never modified — redaction only affects the served preview
- No external services, no telemetry; everything runs inside your Nextcloud

**Limitations**: redaction is best-effort pattern matching, intended to reduce accidental secret leakage when sharing HTML documents. It is not a DLP solution and comes with no leak-prevention guarantee — see SECURITY.md in the repository.

**🔗 Same Window for Nextcloud**

This app ensures that all links on frontend widgets open in the same window/tab instead of opening new windows or tabs in the browser. This provides a more seamless user experience by keeping users within the current Nextcloud interface.

## ✨ Features

- **🔗 Automatic link modification** - Converts all widget links to open in the same window
- **⌨️ Modifier key support** - Ctrl/Cmd/Shift+click and middle-click still open new tabs/windows
- **🎯 Widget-only targeting** - Only affects links within widgets, not navigation elements

**For administrators (Settings → Administration → Share Audit):**
- Dashboard: totals per share type, a 12‑month creation trend, an internal‑vs‑external exposure

- Access lookup: search a user, group or email and see every file they can reach, with revoke‑all.

**For every user (Settings → Personal → My shares audit):**

  revoke), plus a dashboard widget highlighting the links that need your attention.

**ShareGate (Paid sharing)** turns files in your Nextcloud into **paid download links**. Install and enable the app — **no separate ShareGate server** or Node.js service required. Sellers get a dashboard in the Nextcloud sidebar; buyers pay on a clean download page and receive time-limited access.

### For sellers

- **Your shares** — browse your files and create a paid link from any row
- **Paid shares** — copy links, edit price / access days / expiry, or cancel a share
- **Account binding** — Nextcloud admin configures **Stripe**, **PayPal**, or **Alipay Face-to-Face** (Mock mode for development only)
- **Payment ledger** — per-order records with amount, status, and payer account (including masked Alipay logon where available)
- **Statistics** — preview, save-to-cloud, and download counts per share

Set price and how long buyers may download after payment. Share short links like `/apps/sharegate/s/{shareId}`.

### For buyers

- **Paywall** — Alipay QR scan, or redirect to **Stripe Checkout** / **PayPal Checkout**
- **Download** after payment, within the configured access period
- **Cross-device link** — copy a signed link to open the same purchase on another browser or phone
- **Recover access** — already paid? Enter the payment account used at checkout to restore download rights
- **Save to my Nextcloud** — on the same server, logged-in buyers copy files into a `ShareGate/` folder in their drive
- **My purchases** — view purchase history and download again (verify with payment account in private browsing)

- **Alipay Face-to-Face** — China; sandbox or production; async notify URL supported
- **Stripe Checkout** — international cards and wallets

to a specific directory and to proxy WebSocket traffic to a specific URL, as explained in the 'Admin documentation'.

that use SIP over WebSocket, like SIP Trip Phone. Thus, you can connect this application to Telnyx, Localphone, 
Twilio, Flowroute, Vonage, etc. via an Asterisk server, but if you want to connect it directly to the SIP provider,

sociallogin.description:
# Social Login

Make it possible to create users and log in via Telegram, OAuth, or OpenID.

For OAuth, you must create an app with certain providers. Login buttons will appear on the login page if an app ID is specified. Settings are located in the "Social login" section of the settings page.

## Installation

Log in to your Nextcloud installation as an administrator. Under "Apps", click "Download and enable" next to the "Social Login" app.

See below for setup and configuration instructions.

## Custom OAuth2/OIDC Groups

You can use groups from your custom provider. For this, specify the "Groups claim" in the custom OAuth2/OIDC provider settings. This claim should be returned from the provider in the `id_token` or at the user info endpoint. Multiple claims (comma separated) also supported - groups will be merged.
The format should be an `array` or a comma-separated string. E.g., (with a claim named `roles`):

```json
{"roles": ["admin", "user"]}
```
or
```json
{"roles": "admin,user"}
```

Nested claims are also supported. For example, `resource_access.client-id.roles` for:

```json
"resource_access": {
   "client-id": {
     "roles": [
       "client-role-1",
       "client-role-2"
     ]
   }
}
```

**DisplayName** support is also available:
```json
{"roles": [{"gid": 1, "displayName": "admin"}, {"gid": 2, "displayName": "user"}]}
```

You can use provider groups in two ways:

1. Map provider groups to existing Nextcloud groups.
2. Create provider groups in Nextcloud and associate them with users (if the appropriate option is enabled).

To sync groups on every login, ensure the "Update user profile every login" setting is checked.

## Examples for Groups

* Configure WSO2IS to return a roles claim with OIDC [here](https://medium.com/@dewni.matheesha/claim-mapping-and-retrieving-end-user-information-in-wso2is-cffd5f3937ff).
* [GitLab OIDC configuration to allow specific GitLab groups](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/gitlab.md).

## Built-in OAuth Providers

Copy the link from a specific login button to get the correct "redirect URL" for OAuth app settings.

* [Amazon](https://developer.amazon.com/loginwithamazon/console/site/lwa/overview.html)
* [Apple](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/apple.md)
* [Codeberg](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/codeberg.md)
* [Discord](#configure-discord)
* [Facebook](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/facebook.md)
* [GitHub](https://github.com/settings/developers)
* [GitLab](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/gitlab.md)
* [Google](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/google.md)
* [Keycloak](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/keycloak.md)
* [Mail.ru](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/mailru.md)
* **PlexTv**: Use any title as the app ID.
* [Telegram](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/telegram.md)
* [Twitter](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/blob/master/docs/sso/twitter.md)

For details about Google's "Allow login only from specified domain" setting, see [#44](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/issues/44). Use a comma-separated list for multiple domains.

## Configuration

Add `'social_login_auto_redirect' => true` to `config.php` to automatically redirect unauthorized users to social login if only one provider is configured. To temporarily disable this (e.g., for local admin login), add `noredir=1` to the login URL: `https://cloud.domain.com/login?noredir=1`.

Configure HTTP client options using:
```php
  'social_login_http_client' => [
    'timeout' => 45,
    'proxy' => 'socks4://127.0.0.1:9050', // See <https://curl.se/libcurl/c/CURLOPT_PROXY.html> for allowed formats
  ],
```
in `config.php`.

### Configure a Provider via CLI

Use the `occ` utility to configure providers via the command line. Replace variables and URLs with your deployment values:
```bash
php occ config:app:set sociallogin custom_providers --value='{"custom_oidc": [{"name": "gitlab_oidc", "title": "Gitlab", "authorizeUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/authorize", "tokenUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/token", "userInfoUrl": "https://gitlab.my-domain.org/oauth/userinfo", "logoutUrl": "", "clientId": "$my_application_id", "clientSecret": "$my_super_secret_secret", "scope": "openid", "groupsClaim": "groups", "style": "gitlab", "defaultGroup": ""}]}'
```
For Docker, prepend `docker exec -t -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME` to the command or run interactively via `docker exec -it -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME sh`.

To inspect configurations:
```sql
mysql -u nextcloud -p nextcloud
Password: <yourpassword>

> SELECT * FROM oc_appconfig WHERE appid='sociallogin';
```
Or run:
```bash
docker exec -t -uwww-data CONTAINER_NAME php occ config:app:get sociallogin custom_providers
```

### Configure Discord

1. Create a Discord application at [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications).
2. Navigate to `Settings > OAuth2 > General`. Add a redirect URL: `https://nextcloud.mydomain.com/apps/sociallogin/oauth/discord`.
3. Copy the `CLIENT ID` and generate a `CLIENT SECRET`.
4. In Nextcloud, go to `Settings > Social Login`. Paste the `CLIENT ID` into "App id" and `CLIENT SECRET` into "Secret".
5. Select a default group for new users.
6. For group mapping, see [#395](https://github.com/zorn-v/nextcloud-social-login/pull/395).

## Hint

### Callback (Reply) URL
Copy the link from a login button on the Nextcloud login page and use it as the callback URL on your provider's site. To make the button visible temporarily, fill provider settings with placeholder data and update later.

If you encounter callback URL errors despite correct settings, ensure your Nextcloud server generates HTTPS URLs by adding `'overwriteprotocol' => 'https'` to `config.php`.

starrate.description:
StarRate is a professional photo rating and culling tool for photographers, seamlessly integrated into Nextcloud.

Rate photos with 1–5 stars and color labels, flag picks and rejects with keyboard shortcuts, and share a guest gallery link with your client or model. They pick their favorites in the browser — no Nextcloud account required. Leave comments on individual images for feedback rounds, and export the final rating list as CSV when you're done.

**Ratings are written as XMP metadata directly into the JPEG file.** Open it in Lightroom Classic, digiKam, F-Stop or Darktable — the stars are already there. No re-export, no sidecar files. **Coming from Lightroom?** Import your existing XMP ratings with one `occ` command — your years of curation travel with you.

**Browse a whole folder tree at once.** Recursive folder view flattens nested directories into a single sortable, filterable grid — perfect for working through an entire shoot week or a multi-event archive without clicking into every subfolder.

**Built for client presentations.** Slideshow mode in the loupe auto-advances through filtered images at a configurable interval — pre-filter to your three-star picks, hand over the keyboard, and let it run.

**Read the workflow guide:** [Nextcloud as a photo home — what works today (and what is still missing)](https://whitespace.de/en/artikel/nextcloud-foto-workflow/)

**Features:**
- Star ratings (0–5) + color labels (Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/Purple) + Pick/Reject flags
- **Recursive folder view** — browse an entire folder tree as a flat stream or grouped by folder depth (1.3.0+)
- **Loupe slideshow mode** — auto-advance with configurable interval, ideal for client presentations (1.3.2+)
- XMP metadata written into JPEG — Lightroom / Bridge / digiKam compatible
- Configurable XMP label language: Lightroom (German localization) or Bridge / digiKam / English tools (1.3.3+)
- Self-healing XMP read on loupe open — externally-edited files (Lightroom, digiKam) sync their new ratings the next time you click into them, no manual `occ` run needed (1.3.3+)
- Import existing XMP ratings from Lightroom/digiKam via `occ starrate:import-xmp` (with `--recursive` for whole folder trees)
- Comments on individual images — for client feedback rounds or personal notes, optional in guest galleries

threedviewer.description:
A comprehensive 3D model viewer that allows you to view, interact with, and analyze 3D models directly within Nextcloud. Supports 20+ formats across mesh, CAD, and BIM families with full material and texture support.

**📦 Format Support:**
- 🎨 Mesh formats: GLB, GLTF, OBJ+MTL, STL, PLY, FBX, 3MF, 3DS, DAE, X3D, VRML, OFF, AMF
- 🏗️ CAD formats: STEP (.step/.stp), IGES (.iges/.igs), BREP (.brep/.brp), FCSTD (FreeCAD) — powered by a shared OpenCascade (OCCT) runtime
- 🏛️ BIM formats: IFC (via web-ifc WASM), BIM (dotbim JSON), 3DM (Rhinoceros via rhino3dm WASM)
- 🧊 WASM loaders lazy-chunk: a 3–7 MB runtime only downloads when the user opens a file of that format; air-gapped deploys ship their own WASM copies (no CDN required)
- 🚀 Enhanced loaders: Significantly improved FBX, VRML, and DAE loaders with better material and texture support
- 📁 Multi-file models: Full support for OBJ+MTL+textures and GLTF+bins+images
- 🗜️ Compression: DRACO geometry and KTX2/Basis texture compression (needs more work)
- 🔧 Centralized format definitions: Single source of truth for all format definitions ensuring consistency
- ✅ Format sync validation: Automated tests ensure format consistency across backend, frontend, and MIME registration
- 📦 Bundle budget enforcement: Automated bundle size checking with historical tracking and CI integration
 - 🛠️ G-code toolpaths: Support for `.gcode`, `.gco`, `.nc`, `.acode` with 3D toolpath visualization (smooth rainbow gradient coloring, travel/retraction filtering, automatic layer detection)
 - 🧩 Extended G-code ecosystem: Recognizes additional variants `.g`, `.gx` (FlashForge), `.g3drem` (Dremel), `.makerbot`, `.thing` with proper MIME mappings

**🎮 Interactive Features:**
- 🎯 3D Camera Controller: Enhanced intuitive circular controller for precise camera navigation with improved controls
- 🔄 Model comparison: Side-by-side viewing with synchronized controls
- 📝 Annotations: Add notes and markers to specific points on models (always readable, faces camera) with customizable visual sizing controls
- 📏 Measurements: Distance and angle measurement tools (with billboard text) with per-user sizing controls for point size, line thickness, and label width
- 🎬 Animation Controls: Play/pause controls for animated models with loop toggle, timeline scrubber, and frame stepping
- ✂️ Cross-Section: Interactive clipping plane to slice models along X/Y/Z axes for interior inspection
- 💡 Lighting Presets: Quick-switch between Default, Studio, Outdoor, Dramatic, and Flat lighting setups
- 🔖 View Bookmarks: Save and restore camera positions with display state (grid, axes, wireframe, background)
- 💥 Exploded View: Animate multi-mesh models outward from centroid with adjustable factor slider
- 🧭 Face labels: Orientation markers (TOP, BOTTOM, FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT)
- 👁️ Camera projection toggle: Switch between perspective and orthographic views
- ⚙️ Personal Settings: User-specific preferences and settings page in Nextcloud personal settings

**📂 File Browser:**
- 🗂️ Smart navigation: Toggle between Viewer, Folders, Type, Date, and Favorites modes
- 📋 List and Grid views: Switch between compact list view and grid view with customizable default preference
- ⚙️ Default view setting: Set your preferred view mode (Grid/List) in Personal Settings
- ⌨️ Keyboard navigation: Full keyboard support for list view (Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space)
- 🍞 Breadcrumb navigation: Easy navigation back through folder/type/date hierarchies
- 🔄 Lazy loading: Fast navigation with on-demand data loading

**⚡ Export & Tools:**
- 📷 Screenshot capture: Take high-quality PNG/JPEG screenshots of your models
- 💾 Export models to GLB, STL, and OBJ formats
- 🖨️ Slicer integration: Send models directly to PrusaSlicer, Cura, BambuStudio, OrcaSlicer, Simplify3D, Eufy Studio, and AnycubicSlicer with enhanced security (file size limits, MIME validation, rolling expiration)
- 📊 Model statistics panel with detailed information
- 🔲 Wireframe and bounding box visualization
- 📐 Dynamic grid system that adapts to model size and position
- ❓ Help panel with comprehensive in-app documentation

**🚀 Performance & UX:**
- 🖼️ Automatic thumbnails: Smart thumbnail generation with content-aware cropping (configurable in settings)
- 🖼️ Progressive texture loading for improved performance
- 💿 Dependency caching using IndexedDB for faster multi-file loading with live cache statistics (size, entries, hit rate)
- ⚙️ Performance modes with visual quality overlay and automatic suggestions for large models
- 📊 Performance scaling: Automatic performance mode suggestions based on model complexity (triangle count thresholds)
- 📦 Code splitting and dynamic imports
 - 📱 Mobile-optimized UI: Responsive toolbar (icons-only on small screens), full-screen help panel with sticky header, and performance stats hidden by default on mobile (≤768px)
- 🌓 Light and dark theme support with RTL layout
- 🔗 Works with public shares and authenticated users

twofactor_email.description:
### A Two-Factor-Auth Provider using email

Nextcloud supports web logins with a second factor (two-factor authentication,
2FA). To support a certain type of 2FA, a "2FA provider" server app must be
installed. 2FA kicks in after the primary authentication stage (typically
username and password) were successful. This provider challenges the user to
enter a randomly generated authentication code (aka one-time password, OTP,
default: six digits). It sends that code to the user's primary email address
and expects the user to enter it on an additional second step web login page.

### Installation, activation and usage

As with any 2FA provider, two-factor email must be installed and enabled by a
Nextcloud server admin. Additionally, the Nextcloud must have a working email
server configured.

The user may set up any of the installed providers or even multiple. This
provider uses email to send the code and thus can only be enabled if an email
address is set in "Personal info". Mind that a user may not be able to log in
if that email address is invalid (or email server setup of the Nextcloud is
not working properly).

Admins with console access may enable and disable this provider for specified
users via "occ" command. Admins may also enforce 2FA for all users (or specific
groups) via "Admin Settings". This is a Nextcloud feature and not specific to
this provider. If enforced, users with no 2FA are prompted to enable any
installed provider (if they support that feature). This provider supports it
since v3. If the admin installs this provider and enforces 2FA, it should be
ensured that each user does have a valid email address.

Mind that, once a user enabled any 2FA provider, they can no longer use their
password in applications that don't support the web-based 2FA login flow. For
such applications, the user needs to create and use app passwords (to be found
at the bottom of "Personal Settings/Security").

twofactor_oath.description:
Configurable OATH two-factor authentication for Nextcloud, covering all three OATH algorithms in one provider.

- **TOTP** (RFC 6238), **HOTP** (RFC 4226) and **OCRA** challenge-response (RFC 6287), selectable per token
- Per-token hash algorithm (SHA-1 to SHA-512), digits (4 to 10), TOTP period or HOTP counter, and OCRA suite
- Custom or random secrets, with clear strength presets (128 to 640 bit) and secrets encrypted at rest
- A **Strict RFC** switch for safe, interoperable defaults, without losing the freedom to deviate
- Admin-managed enrollment for whole groups, with **bulk provisioning** (sorting, filtering, live validation), CSV export and paste import
- One-click **import from the bundled twofactor_totp**, so existing users switch over without being locked out
- Issuer icon embedded in the QR code, HOTP resynchronisation, and a software OCRA token for testing

Built for hardware OATH tokens and elevated requirements, alongside the simple, bundled twofactor_totp app. OATH (one-time passwords) is not the same as FIDO2/WebAuthn. See documentation for when to use which.

vereinsbuchhaltung.description:
**Buchhaltung für Vereine – vollständig in der eigenen Nextcloud.**

Für Kassenwartinnen und Kassenwarte kleiner und mittlerer Vereine, die keine
Buchhaltungssoftware betreiben und ihre Finanzdaten nicht in eine Cloud eines
Anbieters geben wollen. Die Daten bleiben, wo eure Nextcloud steht.

Man muss kein Buchhalter sein: im **Einfach-Modus** erfasst man „Einnahme" oder
„Ausgabe" mit Betrag, Datum und Kategorie – die doppelte Buchführung im
Hintergrund erledigt die App. Wer Soll und Haben selbst setzen möchte, schaltet
in den Experten-Modus um.

**[▶ Die App in zwei Minuten (Video)](https://youtu.be/eaF-tAQ_OOM)** – Kontoauszüge
importieren, Umsätze zuordnen, auswerten und den Kassenbericht für die
Mitgliederversammlung erzeugen.

## Der Arbeitsablauf

1. **Kontoauszug importieren** – CSV-CAMT, CAMT.053 (XML) oder MT940 aus dem
   Onlinebanking; das Format erkennt die App am Inhalt, die Dateiendung spielt
   keine Rolle. Bereits vorhandene Umsätze werden erkannt und übersprungen,
   auch formatübergreifend. Ein Wachordner kann neue Auszüge sogar von allein
   einlesen, ohne manuellen Import.
2. **Umsätze zuordnen** – jede Bankbuchung bekommt ein Gegenkonto. Regeln
   erledigen wiederkehrende Zuordnungen (Miete, Beiträge, Gebühren) automatisch.
3. **Belege anhängen** – Foto oder PDF, wahlweise in einem Nextcloud-Ordner
   eurer Wahl oder app-intern gespeichert.
4. **Auswerten und berichten** – Kassenbericht für die Mitgliederversammlung,
   Kurzbericht für die Vorstandssitzung, Exporte für die Kassenprüfung.

## Was die App kann

- **Doppelte Buchführung** mit frei definierbarem Kontenrahmen; ein
  Standard-Kontenrahmen für Vereine ist mitgeliefert
- **Kassenbericht** und **Kurzbericht** als druckfertige Seiten (Strg+P), auf
  Wunsch mit Vereinslogo und Akzentfarbe
- **Finanzplan** mit Plan-Ist-Vergleich und einfrierbaren Planständen
- **Gemeinnützigkeit:** Sphären nach dem Vier-Sphären-Modell (ideell,
  Vermögensverwaltung, Zweckbetrieb, wirtschaftlicher Geschäftsbetrieb) und
  Rücklagen nach § 62 AO
- **Mitgliedsbeiträge & SEPA-Lastschrift** (optional, bei Bedarf aktivierbar):
  Mitgliederverwaltung mit CSV-Import, Lastschriftmandate, Beiträge mit
  individueller Zahlungsfrequenz, SEPA-Sammeleinzug als pain.008-Datei für die
  Hausbank – eigener Reiter in der Hauptnavigation; wer das Modul nicht
  braucht, sieht ihn gar nicht
- **Offene Posten** – unbezahlte Forderungen mit Fälligkeit im Blick
- **Mehrjahres-Trend** und Auswertung nach Kostenstellen
- **Jahresabschluss:** ein festgeschriebenes Geschäftsjahr lässt sich nicht mehr
  verändern; fortlaufende, lückenlose Buchungsnummern je Jahr
- **Änderungsprotokoll:** wer hat wann was geändert
- **Rollen:** Verwalter, Buchhalter und Revisor – die Kassenprüfung bekommt
  Lesezugriff auf alles, ohne etwas ändern zu können
- **Für unterwegs:** eigene Ansicht für das Smartphone, Beleg direkt abfotografieren
- **Kassenprüfung:** alle Belege eines Jahres als ZIP, druckfertige

Ein **Beispielverein** lässt sich mit einem Klick anlegen, um alles gefahrlos

Bestehende Daten aus „zero Buchhaltung" können über deren xbuc-Dateien
übernommen werden.

Ausführliches Handbuch auf Deutsch: siehe Dokumentation.

# Description

Workspace allows managers to :
- Create shared workspaces
- Delegate management of each workspace to users (workspace managers) in order for them to:
    - choose members
    - create groups
    - configure advanced permissions on workspace folders
- All through a simple unified interface, designed to simplify your users' experience and make them autonomous

It is necessary to install the Team folders app for the Workspace app to work.

# App configuration

Before using Workspace, you must configure the app, following these important steps:

- Limit the Workspace app to specific groups : in your "application management" administrator interface, limit the application to the following groups: "GeneralManager" and "WorkspacesManagers".

- Configure Team folders for Workspace:
    - In "Settings" > "Team folders" > "Group folder admin delegation" section, add the group "GeneralManager" to the **first** field, and the group "WorkspacesManagers" to the **second** field

If you are using a major version of Nextcloud lower than Nextcloud 25, please follow the instructions provided on [GitHub](https://github.com/arawa/workspace). 

For more information, please visit [our website](https://www.arawa.fr/solutions/produits-arawa/arawa-workspace-for-nextcloud/) (french content).

x2mail.description:
**X2Mail** — Webmail for Nextcloud with native SSO integration.

Log into Nextcloud via Keycloak or any OIDC provider, open Email — done. No extra passwords, no extra login forms. Your OIDC token authenticates directly against IMAP via OAuth2 (OAUTHBEARER/XOAUTH2).

Everything runs through Nextcloud's native APIs — no external services, no separate databases.

### Native Nextcloud Integration
- **Contacts** — read, create, edit contacts via NC Contacts API (all address books visible)
- **Files** — attach files from NC Files, save emails/attachments to NC Files
- **Calendar** — save ICS invitations to NC Calendar with duplicate detection
- **Dashboard** — unread mail widget with automatic OIDC token refresh
- **Search** — find emails via NC Unified Search
- **SSO** — Keycloak, Authentik, any OIDC provider → IMAP without credentials

### Key Features
- **Zero-config SSO** — OAUTHBEARER + XOAUTH2 auto-detected, token auto-refreshed
- **Admin Panel via SSO** — NC admin = engine admin, no separate password
- **Setup Wizard** — preflight checks for IMAP, SMTP, OIDC + JWT diagnostics
- **Native Nextcloud theme** — light + dark mode
- **Sieve filtering** — server-side mail rules
- **Multiple identities** — manage sender aliases
- **OpenPGP / S/MIME** — end-to-end encryption
- **CLI tools** — `occ x2mail:setup`, `occ x2mail:status`

### Setup
```
occ x2mail:setup --imap-host mail.example.com --domain example.com --sieve
```

### Requirements
- Nextcloud 33+, PHP 8.3+
- IMAP server with OAUTHBEARER (Dovecot 2.4+)
- OIDC provider (Keycloak, Authentik, etc.) + `user_oidc`
